alive.last_commit_message:
fix(agent): check the dialed address of direct HTTP connections (#901)

The local-machine guard for http_request and send_request resolved the
destination hostname once, and the HTTP client resolved it again when it
connected. A name that answered with a public address for the check and
a loopback address for the connection (DNS rebinding) reached services
on the operator's machine, with the request's headers.

Direct connections from http_request, send_request, SendRaw (probe and
verify tools) and the target availability probe now use a dialer whose
Control hook applies the same local-machine and listener rule, with the
same opt-ins, to the exact ip:port being connected. Connections to a
configured proxy are unchanged. send_request also uses the guarded
direct client when UseProxy is set but no proxy is active.

Closes the DNS rebinding gap listed as not covered in #887.
